records.name: OpenIT
records.tagline: OpenSource alternative to ServiceNow that runs on ClaudeCode
records.description: The very first software that uses Claude Code as its operating system, building itself around you as you work, and reinventing how IT runs.

records.name: Whiteout
records.tagline: Auto-redact sensitive info from Mac screenshots
records.description: Whiteout sits in your Mac menu bar, watches your screenshots, and auto-detects sensitive info like phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, and API keys. Clean copies saved automatically, originals tucked away. Fully offline. $9.99 once.

records.name: Repaint
records.tagline: Rebuild your existing website with AI
records.description: Paste your website URL and Repaint rebuilds it with AI. It can recreate your pages, migrate your assets, preserve your style, or redesign the site in a completely new direction.

records.name: Atlas Navigation
records.tagline: Predicts your TSA wait before you leave for the airport
records.description: Predict TSA security wait times before you get to the airport. Every other tool shows you what the line looks like right now. Atlas tells you what it'll look like when you arrive. Our machine learning model is trained on millions of real wait time data points across 100+ US airports. After you clear security, report your wait in two taps. Every report makes predictions sharper for everyone. Completely free. No paywall. Know Before You Go.

records.name: Picsart MCP
records.tagline: One connection for 140+ AI models for images and video
records.description: With MCP, AI assistants connect to tools through a single, reusable link. The Picsart MCP server acts as a unified toolbox, giving access to 140+ AI models for image, video, and audio. A request starts in plain English, the assistant selects the right model, and the result appears instantly. No manual setup, switching tools, or learning interfaces. One connection handles everything.

records.name: Riffly
records.tagline: Describe a deck and AI builds it + Exports to PowerPoint
records.description: Riffly is an AI presentation builder you talk to instead of click through. Type your prompt — "10-slide pitch deck, dark theme, investor-ready" — and a full designed deck appears in seconds. Refine it through chat. Click any slide to edit directly. Export a realpptx for PowerPoint or Google Slides. Better than Beautiful.ai — friendlier UX, real free tier, no auto-renewal traps. Free: 3 decks/month, no credit card. Pro: $12/mo or $99/year.

records.name: Mantel
records.tagline: Stop confusing your Claude Code sessions & terminal windows
records.description: A lightweight macOS terminal with per-project colors, icons, and names. Stop confusing 10 identical windows when running your Claude Code sessions. Works and feels just like your normal terminal, but you can actually tell your windows apart and don't lose your sanity.

records.name: Gluten App
records.tagline: Find gluten-free places by city and travel destination
records.description: Gluten App (https://gluten.app) is a web-first gluten-free discovery guide built for celiac-aware decisions, not just reviews. It organizes dedicated gluten-free and celiac-friendly restaurants, bakeries, cafes, shops, airports, landmarks, and travel destinations into structured city guides with safety signals and search-friendly pages.

records.name: Planora
records.tagline: A digital workspace for creative collaboration
records.description: Most project tools force your work into someone else's shape - a fixed Kanban, a flat list, a Gantt grid. Planora throws that out. You draw your team's actual workflow. Discovery → design → build → review → ship — drop tasks in, and they flow through it. It's the same mental model you already sketch on a whiteboard, except it's live, multiplayer, and your tasks actually live inside it.

records.name: Autograph.video Beta
records.tagline: A drag and drop Motion Design tool to swap creatives quickly
records.description: Meet Autograph: A drag and drop Motion Design tool for all type of creators. You can swap images, video, audio and autograph will handle the rest.

records.name: Cleo AI
records.tagline: AI Product Operator for AI-native teams
records.description: Most small product teams spend days reading hundreds of customer messages, GitHub issues, and coding-agent failure traces trying to figure out what to build next. In this era, small AI native teams in B2B can outperform large companies. Cleo does that work for you. Connect your sources, hit Run, and Cleo writes a one-page brief: the top bet, the customers asking, the evidence chain, the draft spec. Cleo watches your metrics and tells you honestly: worked, partially, did not work, or too early.

records.name: Tiny World Builder
records.tagline: Click and build tiny worlds
records.description: Tiny Worlds Builder is a relaxing and fun place to create small worlds of 8x8, 12x12 or larger "boards" all made up of tiles that can contain buildings, trees, farmland, plants and more. Drop a building, then tap it again to change it or drop another next to it and the builds change and adapt automatically. Pan and zoom to see more generative views OR tell AI what kind of world you would like. Once built, play, explore, enter it with VR, display it on a desk in AR or just share it

records.name: mia
records.tagline: Cursor for Product Managers
records.description: Allowing product managers to turn their customer signals into ship-ready requirements for AI to develop.

records.name: Agent-Sin
records.tagline: AI agent that handles repeated tasks through reusable skills
records.description: Agent-Sin is a personal AI agent that handles the small daily chores quietly stealing your time — email, news, todos, "where did I put that?" searches across Slack and notes. Just ask in plain language. Agent-Sin turns your request into a reusable program (a "skill"), so the same task runs reliably, fast, and cheaply — every time. No prompt drift, no surprise bills.

records.name: Kimi WebBridge
records.tagline: A bridge connecting AI agents to the live web
records.description: Kimi WebBridge is the browser extension for AI agents. AI can open pages, click, fill forms, extract info, and automate web tasks.

records.name: Standboy
records.tagline: A Game Boy that wakes up while your agent works
records.description: A Game Boy in your editor sidebar that wakes up while your AI agent works and tucks away when it stops.

records.name: Wowable
records.tagline: Paste a link and get a live website
records.description: Most website builders generate generic pages that all sound the same. Wowable turns reviews, social profiles, screenshots, and business listings into a complete website using the content your business already has online. Paste a Google Maps link, Instagram profile, TripAdvisor page, LinkedIn profile, or even a screenshot — and Wowable turns it into a website that feels authentic instead of AI-generated. No writing. No design. No setup.

records.name: Gradient Bang
records.tagline: Massively multi-player game played by talking to an LLM
records.description: Gradient Bang is a new kind of software: AI-native, built from the ground up to use LLMs everywhere. The game has a dynamic user interface driven by an LLM, conversational voice input, and to win you have to manage a fleet of AI subagents. You can even program your own subagents and run them in Vercel Sandboxes. Built with Pipecat, Daily WebRTC, Supabase, Vercel.

records.name: TrustClaw by Composio
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI agent that connects 1000+ apps on Vercel
records.description: TrustClaw is a personal AI agent that you can self-host on Vercel with one command. Powered by Composio, it connects to 1000+ apps over OAuth, runs scheduled jobs on its own, and talks to you on the web or Telegram. It is fully open-sourced, MIT-licensed and ready for you to take over.

records.name: PHBench
records.tagline: Predict the next Series A from a ProductHunt launch
records.description: PHBench: the first public benchmark predicting Series A funding from Product Hunt launch signals. We analyzed 67,292 featured launches over 7 years, linked to 528 verified Series A rounds via Crunchbase. Champion model: 4.7x lift over random. Team size × community engagement is the strongest signal; B2B (API, Payments, Fintech) converts at 3x baseline; Rank #1 raises at 2.2x unranked. Dataset, code, and baselines open. Submit at phbench.com and subscribe for weekly high-probability launches.

records.name: Sleek Analytics v3
records.tagline: A simple Google Analytics alternative for the modern web.
records.description: Sleek Analytics is a privacy-first Google Analytics alternative for Modern Web. Real-time website analytics, cookieless tracking, and fast dashboards. We built Sleek because analytics shouldn't require a PhD. Paste one line of code, and within seconds you're watching real visitors move through your site live. No setup headaches, no cookie banners, no noise. Just your data, clean and simple.

records.name: HasData
records.tagline: Web scraping service for AI agents
records.description: HasData is the managed web scraping service for data pipelines and AI agents. Send any URL, get clean JSON or Markdown back in one API call. We handle proxies, browser rendering, retries, and anti-bot. 50+ ready scrapers cover Google Search, Maps, News, Zillow, Indeed, and major e-commerce. AI extraction handles any other URL from a plain-text prompt. Use it from Claude, ChatGPT, or your own AI agent via MCP. CLI for everything else.

records.name: AgentRail
records.tagline: A local control plane for AI coding agents
records.description: AgentRail is the open-source task lifecycle layer for coding agents. Agents can write code — the hard part is everything else: picking the right ticket, watching CI, incorporating review feedback, merging when it's ready. It connects agents to GitHub, Linear, and CI with structured typed events instead of raw webhooks and log walls. - Per-agent scoped auth - Rules-based task-> agent routing, - structured CI summaries. - Apache 2.0 licensed. Runs locally.

records.name: Cats Lock
records.tagline: Lock your Mac keyboard so your cat can walk on it.
records.description: Most keyboard-locking apps were built for keyboard cleaning. Cats Lock is built for the cat moment. What stands out: • Stealth Lock mode (silent + invisible) for meetings • Customizable warning sound, with import for your own • ⌘L from main window or menu bar • Sandboxed, no analytics, no account • $2.99 one-time, no subscription Built by an indie developer for himself and his cat to enjoy.

records.name: OpenHuman
records.tagline: An open source AI harness built with the human in mind
records.description: 90% of people who try AI agents give up. Three reasons: memory that resets every session, your data sitting in someone else's cloud and a terminal just to get started. Real blockers. OpenHuman fixes all of it. Local-first, privacy-first. It remembers everything about you and actually gets smarter the more you use it. Every feature lives in one simple interface. Fully open source. One-click setup. P.S. The product is in beta, so expect bugs, but we're building and shipping fast.

records.name: Just The Tips
records.tagline: A stablecoin tip-jar bot for Discord, Telegram, Twitch, & X
records.description: Non-custodial multi-chain stablecoin tipping bot for creators. Run your own. Four chains. No custody. No accounts. No nonsense.

records.name: Lensmor
records.tagline: Turn exhibitor data into pre-booked sales meetings
records.description: Unlike generic contact databases, Lensmor starts with exhibitor data, helping teams discover relevant events, find exhibiting companies, identify decision-makers, reveal verified emails, and book meetings before the show begins. Standout features include 160,000+ global events, exhibitor search, reverse company-to-event lookup, CSV export, and an AI agent for lead discovery and outreach planning.

records.name: Mobius
records.tagline: Describe a trade and Mobius builds, backtests, and runs it
records.description: Retail traders are stuck between no-code tools that can't flex and quant stacks that take weeks to set up. The idea is fast. The execution isn't. Mobius turns plain-English strategies into deployed trading bots backtested on real market data, running on alternative signals like congressional trades, dark pools, and Reddit sentiment. No code, no context switching, no alpha decay. Strategy. Backtest. Live. In minutes.

records.name: Glance
records.tagline: Preview .md files instantly with quick look
records.description: Glance is a fully free native macOS Quick Look extension for Markdown files. Press Space on anymd file in Finder and get an instant, cleanly rendered preview instead of raw syntax. Built for developers working with README files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, specs, notes, and AI-generated docs. Supports tables, code blocks, links, images, LaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and smart zoom. Works fully offline, weighs only 8.3 MB, and has zero telemetry.

records.name: Crustimate
records.tagline: Free tool to fix your LinkedIn to get found by AI recruiters
records.description: AI recruiting tools now filter candidates before any human sees your name. Paste your LinkedIn URL and get your AI readiness score in 30 seconds. See exactly what's hurting your visibility, get a rewritten profile, and a prioritised fix list so recruiters can actually find you. All for free!

records.name: Basedash MCP Connectors
records.tagline: Connect any app and take action anywhere
records.description: Basedash already reads from your databases, warehouses, and SaaS tools. Now it can act on them too. Connect any MCP server — Linear, HubSpot, Slack, Resend, Notion, GitHub — and the Basedash agent gets new tools it can use right inside chat. Ask it to email your latest signups, file a Linear bug from a support ticket, or update a HubSpot lead based on what a user did in your product. Pair with Automations to run the whole flow on a schedule. Connect any app. Take action anywhere.

records.name: Cline SDK
records.tagline: Build coding agents with a plugin-based open-source runtime
records.description: Cline SDK is an open-source TypeScript agent runtime with plugin architecture, native subagents, MCP support, checkpointing, cron jobs, and web fetch. For developers building custom coding agents or CLI tools.

records.name: Noeth
records.tagline: The coding interview AI that lets you bring your own API key
records.description: Tired of $100–300/month coding interview AI subscriptions? Noeth is an invisible desktop overlay that gives you real-time help during technical interviews, LeetCode solutions, code review, voice Q&A, live transcription, flowcharts and much more. Bring your own Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, or Ollama key and pay at cost. No subscription ever. $12.90 one-time lifetime license for 3 devices. Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The alternative to Interview Coder, Cluely, Parakeet AI, and LockedIn AI.

records.name: DevRecorder
records.tagline: Screen recorder with console, network, errors & annotations
records.description: DevRecorder is a Chrome extension that records your screen alongside console logs, network requests, and navigation events — all on one synchronized timeline. Hit record, reproduce a bug, and share a link. Your team sees the video with every log, request header, response body, and route change locked to the exact frame. Works on localhost, staging, and production. Connect via MCP and AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf can read your recordings as structured context.

records.name: Atter AI
records.tagline: AI transcription app that turns meetings into action items
records.description: Atter AI is an AI transcription app for meetings, interviews, lectures, and podcasts. Unlike basic voice-to-text tools, Atter AI turns every recording into a verbatim transcript with speaker labels, an AI summary, action items, decisions, and a mind map. Ask questions about any recording with built-in AI chat. Supports 90+ languages with real-time bilingual translation. Works on iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Export to Word or PDF.

records.name: Relay
records.tagline: Stop repeating yourself to every AI
records.description: ❌ Every time you open a new AI chat, you paste the same context all over again — your stack, decisions, constraints, where you left off 🛠️ Relay fixes this. It captures what matters from your AI chats and keeps a living project brief ready. One click injects your full context into any fresh conversation 🦾 Via MCP, your IDE agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Codex, etc.) read and write the same brief, synced automatically Works with: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more. Free to start

records.name: SpotFetch by DocentPro
records.tagline: Turn the posts you save into an organized list of places
records.description: SpotFetch turns the Instagram/Tiktok/Youtube videos you already save into an organized list of real places. Forward any Instagram, TikTok, or Youtube video to DocentPro - every café, viewpoint and hidden gem is auto-extracted into a Collection, ready to plan a trip around.

records.name: Agentic Website Builder 2.0 by Lokuma
records.tagline: Design, build, and run your site with a design agent harness
records.description: Lokuma 2.0 is a design-aware agent harness for websites. Most AI builders can generate a first draft. But real sites need structure, taste, brand consistency, editing, publishing, forms, and ongoing updates. Lokuma connects planning, design, style, assets, site state, edits, and publishing into one agentic workflow — so your website feels designed, not just generated. Design, build, and run your site with agents.

records.name: DramaBox by Resemble AI
records.tagline: AI turns scene descriptions into vocal performances
records.description: A TTS model should give you two things: an oscar-worthy performance and a verifiable signature to prove it's yours. DramaBox is the first to do both. Describe a scene the way you would to an actor, like 'a talk show host gasps in mock shock, bursts into laughter,' and the model interprets it as performance. Every output is watermarked with Resemble Watermarker. Open source, English-only for now, find it in your Resemble account or on Hugging Face.

records.name: Magic Notebook
records.tagline: A calm writing app with no complexity and no AI
records.description: ✨Magic Notebook✨ is a calm writing app for people who just want to write. No clutter. No complex systems. No AI. • Just open the app and start typing — no setup, no learning curve • Write in a familiar way, with full support for DOCX • Add images and tables without breaking your flow • Your files stay on your device — no lock-in, no forced cloud Built for writers, journalists, and anyone who wants a simple, focused writing experience — without technical overhead.

records.name: Nimbus
records.tagline: Agentic Browser with Claude Code UX
records.description: Nimbus is an agentic browser inspired by Claude Code UX. Tell it what you want in plain English. It handles the mechanical work: clicks, forms, file pickers, multi-tab coordination and pauses to ask only when there's something only you can decide. Inspired by the way Claude Code feels for coding; built for the rest of the web. Built from the ground up, not an extension. Free for the first 500 founding users forever.

records.name: PostMaster
records.tagline: AI Writing Assistant That Sounds Human & Eliminates AI Slop
records.description: Polish AI-generated content, catch 80+ AI tells, and preserve your unique voice. Write with AI assistance that doesn't sound like AI slop.

records.name: Vastiko
records.tagline: Browser-only file tools. Zero uploads. Zero backend.
records.description: Privacy-first toolkit running entirely in your browser. Passport photo maker with 18 country presets, pixel-perfect PDF editor, plus 26 conversion and organize tools. No backend, no database, no upload pipeline. Files physically can't leave your device

records.name: 3D AI People Counter
records.tagline: Privacy-first AI people counting camera
records.description: HX‑CCD21 is a privacy‑focused 3D AI people counting camera. It provides real‑time footfall, age/gender stats, dwell time and ReID deduplication without personal data collection. With IP66 waterproof design, PoE power supply and open API support, it fits retail, malls, offices and public areas. Local offline storage and free cloud reports help businesses optimize space operation easily.

records.name: Finezza
records.tagline: AI-powered lending lifecycle platform for NBFCs and Banks
records.description: Finezza is India's only lending OS that unifies LOS, LMS, and co-lending on one no-code platform — built ground-up for NBFCs, banks, and fintechs.Launch loan products in 2 hours. Get AI credit decisions in under 3 seconds. Run RBI-compliant bank-NBFC co-lending with automated fund splits, dual underwriting, and live reconciliation. 100+ India-native integrations. Zero developer dependency.

records.name: TryApplyNow
records.tagline: Tailor your resume, score jobs, and reach referrals faster
records.description: TryApplyNow helps job seekers apply smarter with AI-powered resume tailoring, job match scoring, and recruiter email discovery. Instead of mass applying with the same resume, users can optimize resumes for each role, understand their fit before applying, and connect directly with hiring teams. Free to start.

records.name: Webeix
records.tagline: Launch a Professional Website for your business in seconds
records.description: Webeix is an easy-to-use website builder that helps businesses launch professional websites in seconds without coding. Choose from beautifully designed templates, edit content live, customize your branding, and publish instantly. With built-in SEO tools, responsive designs, and simple pricing, Webeix gives you everything needed to create and grow your online presence. Start free for 15 days with no credit card required.

records.name: Vibecheck by Open Notes
records.tagline: Like a weather report for online conversations
records.description: Analyze URLs and PDFs for tone, claims, safety, and opinions. Unlike most AI moderation and detection tools, Vibecheck analyzes conversations in the context of the community they were posted in — helping you understand tone, escalation, spam, claims, disagreement, and what’s actually happening in the thread.

records.name: UQR.ai
records.tagline: The QR code platform built for modern brands
records.description: UQR.ai is the QR code platform built for modern brands. Design fully customizable codes that match your visual identity, track every scan in real time, and update dynamic links without reprinting. No clunky enterprise dashboards, no eyesore black squares — just branded, trackable QR codes that look as good as they perform.

records.name: FestiPlannr

records.description: FestiPlannr is now on mobile!! Festivals are now available downloadable + available offline, and schedule creation now comes with a lot more functionality! Key features: - Festival downloads (offline access) - Live group heatmaps w/ filters - Customizable schedule UI - Phone wallpaper export - EZ map pin + share - Festival-wide stats - Live weather + flight data - Festival calendar - Festival update notifications - Share what albums/tracks are currently in your rotation!

records.name: Sabero

records.description: La plataforma colombiana para el ICFES Saber 11. Simulacros cronometrados, tutor IA por pregunta, coach personalizado y análisis detallado. Prueba gratis sin tarjeta.

records.name: SIGI

records.description: Most e-signature tools stop at "signed." SIGI doesn't. The moment a contract is signed, SIGI automatically spins up a project, generates an invoice, creates onboarding tasks, and marks the deal won zero manual work. Unlike DocuSign or HelloSign, SIGI lives inside your business. CRM data auto-fills contracts. AI surfaces signing patterns to improve close rates. Sign smarter. Close faster. Let SIGI handle the rest.

records.name: Whiteout
records.tagline: Auto-redact sensitive info from Mac screenshots
records.description: Whiteout sits in your Mac menu bar, watches your screenshots, and auto-detects sensitive info like phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, and API keys. Clean copies saved automatically, originals tucked away. Fully offline. $9.99 once.

records.name: Florea
records.tagline: A calm plant journal with smart care reminders
records.description: Florea is a calm plant care journal for houseplant lovers. Create smart reminders for watering, fertilizing, pruning, and more; record growth moments with photos and notes; check light conditions; and generate beautiful share cards. It helps beginners and plant enthusiasts build better care habits while keeping every plant’s story alive.

records.name: EstateCoin
records.tagline: Real estate income for everyone — Start as low as from ₹100
records.description: Real estate has always been India's best investment. But buying property needs ₹50 lakh, a broker, EMI, and years of lock-in. Only the rich could play. EstateCoin breaks that barrier. Own a share of income-generating real estate and earn daily rental income — the same income landlords earn. Start from ₹100. Income from day 3. Exit anytime via our live marketplace. No EMI. No broker. No lock-in. Real estate was always the best investment. We just made it accessible.

records.name: ShipThatCode
records.tagline: Stop watching tutorials. Start shipping real systems
records.description: Learn programming by building real systems from scratch. Redis, Git, a database, a compiler — every lesson is choose, write, run.

records.name: Vyroom

records.description: Vyroom is a real estate marketplace that simplifies property search, rental, and discovery in Côte d’Ivoire. Our mission is to modernize real estate in Africa, starting with Côte d’Ivoire.

records.name: BIDBridgeVen Platform
records.tagline: Rescuing GovCon bidders from AI fragmentation and chaos
records.description: BIDBridgeVen is the first end-to-end operating system for GovCon bidders, helping SMBs manage government contracting through one connected ecosystem. As organizations face a major operational shift in proposal workflows, BIDBridgeVen solves a larger challenge: fragmentation. Although AI tools continue to evolve rapidly, many SMBs still experience gaps in cohesion, continuity, visibility, and operational structure. Businesses shouldn’t have to stitch together AI tools just to compete for a bid!

records.name: DoorProfit
records.tagline: See the crime before you sign the lease

records.name: LegacyLens
records.tagline: Visualize GitHub repos as a Code City. Find tech debt.

Click any building to open the Inspector: full metrics for that file plus AI analysis — what's risky, what might break, what to refactor first. Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue. records.name: MyBabe AI
records.tagline: The AI companion that actually remembers you

records.name: Darts Logbook

records.name: fbdownloaderhd

records.name: KingStudio — AI Product Photos

records.description: Create professional AI product photos instantly. No subscription — pay only when you need. Simply upload your image and let AI create stunning product visuals ready for ecommerce, marketing, and social media.

records.name: Mind Focus: Android app for fast focus

records.description: Mind Focus is an Android App that combines the Pomodoro technique with adaptive and smart isochronic tones generated in real time. Based on evidence, it adapts to your time of day and ultradian rhythms. The app also includes proven techniques to take back your attention and lower stress. No subscription, no ads, no data collection. 100% offline.

records.name: Better Without Booze

At the centre is the Identity Studio: a Sims-meets-Persona-5 system where you map the different drinking identities inside you as actual battling characters who combat within the craving tracker.

records.name: RecallHub
records.tagline: Remember Everything. Forget Nothing
records.description: RecallHub is your personal memory hub for meetings, notes, and project updates. With smart search, reminders, and cross-meeting memory, RecallHub makes sure nothing slips through the cracks — so your team can focus on action, not recollection.

records.name: God.AI

records.name: Bot-Me

records.description: Découvrez ClarioTV, votre abonnement IPTV France compatible Smart TV, Android, iOS, PC, Roku, Fire TV et Apple TV. Activation rapide, qualité HD/4K et support 24/7.

We find the best podcast episodes relevant to building a business online and summarize them so you can decide if you want to spend time listening and learning direct from the source. Logins to access more detailed summaries coming soon. Signup to the newsletter to keep upto date with features. Subscribe to the RSS feed to keep up to date with the best podcast episodes.

records.name: DevRecorder
records.tagline: Screen recorder with console, network, errors & annotations
records.description: DevRecorder is a Chrome extension that records your screen alongside console logs, network requests, and navigation events — all on one synchronized timeline. Hit record, reproduce a bug, and share a link. Your team sees the video with every log, request header, response body, and route change locked to the exact frame. Works on localhost, staging, and production. Connect via MCP and AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf can read your recordings as structured context.

records.name: Agentic Website Builder 2.0 by Lokuma
records.tagline: Design, build, and run your site with a design agent harness
records.description: Lokuma 2.0 is a design-aware agent harness for websites. Most AI builders can generate a first draft. But real sites need structure, taste, brand consistency, editing, publishing, forms, and ongoing updates. Lokuma connects planning, design, style, assets, site state, edits, and publishing into one agentic workflow — so your website feels designed, not just generated. Design, build, and run your site with agents.

records.name: ProposalGenius AI
records.tagline: Your private AI co-pilot for RFP responses
records.description: Tired of wasting hours on RFPs and proposals? ProposalGenius AI is your dedicated co-pilot for crafting professional, winning proposals in minutes. Why choose ProposalGenius AI? Instant Proposals: Generate high-quality drafts from scratch or past proposals to match your unique voice and winning style. RFP requirement extraction Built-in Design Templates: Select from modern, corporate, or minimalist styles for polished results. Private & Secure: Your data always remains yours.

records.name: Lensmor
records.tagline: Turn exhibitor data into pre-booked sales meetings
records.description: Unlike generic contact databases, Lensmor starts with exhibitor data, helping teams discover relevant events, find exhibiting companies, identify decision-makers, reveal verified emails, and book meetings before the show begins. Standout features include 160,000+ global events, exhibitor search, reverse company-to-event lookup, CSV export, and an AI agent for lead discovery and outreach planning.

records.name: Frittu
records.tagline: Fridge Scanner & Meal Planner
records.description: Hey PH 👋 I'm Arjun — solo dev, based in Australia. I kept coming home with a fridge full of random ingredients and no idea what to cook. Every recipe app assumed you'd planned ahead. I hadn't. So I built Frittu. Point your camera at your fridge, get AI recipes personalised to your cuisine, goals, and allergens — right now, with what you have. 6 months of solo building. Live on the App Store today. Free to download, sign up takes 30 seconds.

records.name: Chronicle Health
records.tagline: Chronicle Health brings together your medical records and +
records.description: Chronicle Health brings together your medical records, AI second brain, daily planning, and discipline tools — each module independent, all working together.

records.name: GEO Checker for AI Search
records.tagline: Free AI visibility checker for ChatGPT, Gemini and AI search
records.description: GEO Checker helps website owners, marketers, developers and SEO teams test how AI search systems understand a website. It checks robots.txt, AI bot access, llms.txt, sitemap, schema, metadata, technical SEO and machine-readable discovery signals in one free report.

records.name: Atter AI
records.tagline: AI transcription app that turns meetings into action items
records.description: Atter AI is an AI transcription app for meetings, interviews, lectures, and podcasts. Unlike basic voice-to-text tools, Atter AI turns every recording into a verbatim transcript with speaker labels, an AI summary, action items, decisions, and a mind map. Ask questions about any recording with built-in AI chat. Supports 90+ languages with real-time bilingual translation. Works on iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Export to Word or PDF.

records.name: AethrionX
records.tagline: AI product manager with institutional memory
records.description: In March, your senior engineer spent a week figuring out how to build your search system. She ruled out the obvious queuing approach — too slow, too expensive at scale — and picked something better. She wrote it all down. She left in October. Last month, a new engineer started rebuilding the same system using the exact approach she ruled out. Six months of work, repeating a solved mistake. AethrionX would have shown him her research the moment he opened the ticket.

records.name: Meigen Ai
records.tagline: AI image prompts gallery and image-to-prompt generator
records.description: Meigen AI is an AI image prompt gallery and image-to-prompt generator for creators, designers, and marketers. Browse prompt examples for product photography, posters, portraits, logos, thumbnails, wallpapers, and creative visuals. You can copy prompts, explore model-based examples, or upload a reference image to turn it into a reusable AI prompt. Meigen AI helps creators go from visual inspiration to structured prompts faster.

records.name: Avatar Image Chat AI
records.tagline: Avatar Image Chat AI for Casual. Completely Free.
records.description: This is an AI chat that uses a browser-integrated LLM. Because the browser-integrated LLM runs on the device, there is zero server load. As a result, there are absolutely no usage limits, and you can chat as much as you want for free. You can freely change the image of the conversation partner, allowing you to chat while imagining a specific person or character.

records.name: AgentShield
records.tagline: Prompt injection detection API for AI agents
records.description: AgentShield is a prompt injection classifier that sits between untrusted input and your AI agent. One API call classifies any text — user messages, RAG documents, tool outputs — and returns a verdict before it reaches the model. Think of it as a WAF for LLMs. Why we built it: Johns Hopkins researchers hijacked Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot through prompt injection. The three biggest AI companies couldn't stop it. We built an external security layer that does.

records.name: Postspout
records.tagline: Turn any blog post into 7 ready-to-post pieces in 30 seconds
records.description: Postspout repurposes any blog post into 7 platform-ready pieces in seconds. No audio upload. No email delays. You get: ✓ LinkedIn post (hook-first, story-driven) ✓ LinkedIn carousel (7 slides, Canva-ready) ✓ 3 Tweets (different angles) ✓ Threads post ✓ Newsletter section + subject line ✓ 2 Instagram captions + hashtags ✓ Blog summary Unlike Castmagic (audio only) or Taplio (LinkedIn only, $65/mo) — Postspout is for text creators. Free: 3 repurposes, no card needed. Plans: $9/$19/$39/month.

records.name: Relay
records.tagline: Stop repeating yourself to every AI
records.description: ❌ Every time you open a new AI chat, you paste the same context all over again — your stack, decisions, constraints, where you left off 🛠️ Relay fixes this. It captures what matters from your AI chats and keeps a living project brief ready. One click injects your full context into any fresh conversation 🦾 Via MCP, your IDE agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Codex, etc.) read and write the same brief, synced automatically Works with: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more. Free to start

records.name: DramaBox by Resemble AI
records.tagline: AI turns scene descriptions into vocal performances
records.description: A TTS model should give you two things: an oscar-worthy performance and a verifiable signature to prove it's yours. DramaBox is the first to do both. Describe a scene the way you would to an actor, like 'a talk show host gasps in mock shock, bursts into laughter,' and the model interprets it as performance. Every output is watermarked with Resemble Watermarker. Open source, English-only for now, find it in your Resemble account or on Hugging Face.

records.name: SpotFetch by DocentPro
records.tagline: Turn the posts you save into an organized list of places
records.description: SpotFetch turns the Instagram/Tiktok/Youtube videos you already save into an organized list of real places. Forward any Instagram, TikTok, or Youtube video to DocentPro - every café, viewpoint and hidden gem is auto-extracted into a Collection, ready to plan a trip around.

records.name: Drafidox
records.tagline: AI-powered PDF, OCR, and document conversion tools
records.description: Drafidox is an AI-powered document conversion platform offering tools like PDF to Word, image-to-text OCR, PDF compression, and file conversion utilities for faster online productivity.

records.name: iPDF — Vos documents, pilotés par l'IA
records.tagline: The PDF toolkit with built-in AI — no limits, no ads
records.description: iPDF est l'outil PDF boosté par l'IA. Fusionnez, séparez, résumez, traduisez et extrayez vos documents en quelques secondes.

records.name: Custom Rigid Boxes Wholesale
records.tagline: Custom Rigid Boxes That Elevate Your Brand
records.description: Shop custom rigid boxes in any size and style, flip top, magnetic closure, two-piece and more. Low MOQ, free design help, 7-day turnaround. Get a free quote today.

records.name: Real Love Fm
records.tagline: Elevate your style with Real Love Fm
records.description: In a world where fashion constantly evolves, one thing remains timeless — the desire to express individuality. Fashion is no longer just about clothing; it has become a personal statement, a cultural identity, and a reflection of lifestyle. That is exactly where Real Love FM stands apart. The brand delivers a curated collection of urban-inspired apparel that combine creativity, comfort, and street culture into one powerful fashion experience. Contact Now! Contact @ https://www.reallovefm.com/

records.name: LinkPress
records.tagline: Stop sharing tracking junk · Get clean links with LinkPress™
records.description: LinkPress™ is a web application (WebApp) that removes query strings, tracking codes, search parameters, and other unnecessary data from URL links, so you can share clean, human-readable addresses instead of long tracking-heavy ones. It's especially useful when you want to shorten links for text chats, social media posts, newsletters, or when embedding references into documents and articles without leaking analytics or referral information.

records.name: Capple AI
records.tagline: Snap food. AI tracks your calories instantly.
records.description: Claude responded: Capple skips the food database. Capple skips the food database. Just snap a photo — AI instantly identifies your meal and logs calories & macros automatically. What makes it different: — AI Food Scan that actually works — Cycle Tracking built-in (4 hormonal phases) — Cheat Day planning without guilt — Personalized macros based on your BMR/TDEE Clean interface. No overwhelm. Just the data you need to hit your goal.

records.name: Zenkai
records.tagline: Web vulnerability scanner for freelancers & SMBs
records.description: Zenkai scans your website for critical vulnerabilities like XSS, SQL injection, CSRF, SSRF, and more, and explains them in plain language anyone can understand. No security expertise needed. Unlike generic free scanners, Zenkai gives you an actionable report with clear explanations, expert advice on fixes, and an optional pentest to simulate real attacks on your weaknesses. Built for freelancers and small businesses who need real security without enterprise pricing.

records.name: Chronor
records.tagline: chronorcom
records.description: chronorcom

records.name: VEQO
records.tagline: Figma Plugin
records.description: Veqo — Capture any webpage and import it into Figma as editable design. Auto-scrolls, extracts components and builds design systems. Overview Figma Plugin https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1624212681888949529/html-to-design-veqo Veqo is an advanced design extraction engine that transforms any live webpage into clean, structured, and fully editable Figma designs — complete with Auto Layout, Components, Design Tokens, and scalable Design Systems.

records.name: StockLens
records.tagline: AI Native Operating System for Finance
records.description: StockLens runs 25+ deterministic agents across SEC filings, enforcement actions, insider transactions, and government policy — then assembles everything into a single intelligence view per company. Every signal traces to a raw document. No AI hallucination. $49/mo.

records.name: Score
records.tagline: Live football scores without keeping 5 tabs open.
records.description: Score is a Chrome extension for football fans who want to follow live matches without constantly switching between tabs. It brings live scores, fixtures, standings, favorite teams, match alerts, football news, themes, and pinned matches into one clean browser popup. Whether you’re working, studying, browsing, or watching another game, Score helps you stay updated without keeping multiple score websites open.

records.name: SnapStoryView
records.tagline: Anonymous Snapchat story viewer & downloader
records.description: SnapStoryView is a free online tool to view Snapchat stories anonymously and download Snapchat stories and Snapchat Spotlight videos. It works as a Snapchat story viewer, Snapchat story downloader, Snapchat Spotlight downloader, Snapchat reel downloader, story downloader for Snapchat, and Snapchat anonymous viewer — all in one place. No login required. Fast, free, and works directly from your browser. Watch and save stories without revealing your identity.

records.name: Morph
records.tagline: Know your look before you change it
records.description: Morph is a generative interface for exploring alternate versions of yourself through hair, beard, and grooming transformations. Know your look before you change it. No guesswork, no regret

records.name: Code2Clip
records.tagline: Turn code snippets into short videos for social feeds
records.description: Turn code snippets into short videos for social feeds. Pick a theme, an animation, and a real keyboard sound, then render an MP4 ready for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, or LinkedIn. No editor, no After Effects, no manual screen recording.

records.name: Nexa claw
records.tagline: NexaClaw — simplifying OpenClaw AI deployment
records.description: Deploy your personal OpenClaw AI assistant in under 1 minute with Nexaclaw. One-click setup for Telegram, WhatsApp & Discord. No servers or technical skills required. Start using autonomous AI agents for 24/7 productivity

records.name: PromptAI 360
records.tagline: ⌘⇧P in Cursor, Claude Code etc, get structured prompt in 2
records.description: PromptAI 360 turns rough text into a structured AI prompt — anywhere on your Mac. Press ⌘⇧P inside Cursor, Claude Code, Warp, VS Code, or any text input. Highlight, hit the hotkey, get a role-defined, context-rich prompt back in 2 seconds. Chrome extension companion at 5.0★ with 5,000+ prompts enhanced. We don't train on your prompts. 5-day free trial, no card. From $7.99/mo. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity. Built solo. Launching on Vercel Day.

records.name: Cigyl
records.tagline: The missing link!
records.description: With CiYGL you will be able to go from storyboard to engine in 23 clicks. CiGYL has solved the friction dilemma. Now artists will be able to create on the "fly". Your sitting in the park, you have an idea and its great!, you see the characters and the locations in your head, how they move, you see the landscape, Now what! Don't get up, just open your laptop go to CiGYL.com and make it!

records.name: ChargePilot
records.tagline: Glass-box AI. Won disputes. 15%. No subscription
records.description: Stop chargebacks before they happen. ChargePilot uses 12 AI signals to automatically prevent and fight Stripe disputes. 15% on recoveries, $15 per successful Stripe EFW prevention, $0.20 per scan after your first 1,000 free scans. No monthly subscription. Free to install from the Stripe App Marketplace.

records.name: GoalPaddy: Accountability Groups
records.tagline: Turn goals into shared progress and real consistency
records.description: GoalPaddy helps people stay consistent and finish their goals through accountability, structure, and shared progress. Create goals, break them into milestones, track habits, and join accountability groups (“Paddies”) where friends can motivate each other and monitor progress together. We also added intelligent progress summaries, motivational insights, and smarter task planning to help users understand how they’re performing — not just what they planned.

records.name: Magic Notebook
records.tagline: A calm writing app with no complexity and no AI
records.description: ✨Magic Notebook✨ is a calm writing app for people who just want to write. No clutter. No complex systems. No AI. • Just open the app and start typing — no setup, no learning curve • Write in a familiar way, with full support for DOCX • Add images and tables without breaking your flow • Your files stay on your device — no lock-in, no forced cloud Built for writers, journalists, and anyone who wants a simple, focused writing experience — without technical overhead.

records.name: GenAI 0-to-1 Without the Hype
records.tagline: A Small Site That Explains LLM/Agents Without the Hype
records.description: Practical learning path on key LLM/agent concepts and what they mean in practice. No jargons. Beginner friendly.

records.name: Trusted Power Supply Dealers in Mumbai
records.tagline: powersupplydealersinmumbai, siemenspowersupplyinmumbai
records.description: Searching for reliable power supply dealers in Mumbai? Look no further than the reputable power solution providers at Ranade's SR Systems. We have years of experience catering to industries as well as commercial establishments. We supply a wide variety of power supplies that guarantee performance, safety, and longevity. From voltage stabilizers to uninterrupted power supply, we stock some of the best models available on the market. We take the time to understand your power requirements.

records.name: Reverse Tax Calculator
records.tagline: Reverse sales tax and tax extraction calculator for U.S.
records.description: Reverse Tax Calculator helps users calculate reverse sales tax, extract tax from total prices, and estimate tax-inclusive amounts across U.S. states quickly and accurately.

records.name: Wallies
records.tagline: The all-in-one platform to create, monetize and grow online.
records.description: Wallies is a next-generation digital platform that combines social media, AI companions, virtual avatars, creator marketplaces, and interactive communities into

records.name: Bounso
records.tagline: Verify Every Email. Even Catch-All In seconds
records.description: B2B email verification with 99.2% accuracy. Bounso verifies individual mailboxes on catch-all domains — something no other tool does. Recover 40% of leads your competitors ignore. Real-time API, bulk uploads, and webhooks for GTM teams protecting deliverability.

records.name: Smart CCTV Alerts Private AI Monitoring
records.tagline: Turn any CCTV feed into a smart alert system
records.description: Detects people in any video or CCTV feed Shows live bounding boxes on screen Sends instant alerts when activity is detected Works on any website with video (CCTV, streams, recordings)

records.name: Nimbus
records.tagline: Agentic Browser with Claude Code UX
records.description: Nimbus is an agentic browser inspired by Claude Code UX. Tell it what you want in plain English. It handles the mechanical work: clicks, forms, file pickers, multi-tab coordination and pauses to ask only when there's something only you can decide. Inspired by the way Claude Code feels for coding; built for the rest of the web. Built from the ground up, not an extension. Free for the first 500 founding users forever.

records.name: REFINA
records.tagline: Luxury campaign visuals in 3 clicks. Zero prompts.
records.description: Built by a luxury insider. For brands who were never let in. 3 clicks. Zero prompts. Upload your product. Get a campaign that looks like Vogue.

records.name: The Box
records.tagline: Guess the game from the screenshot. New round every day.
records.description: Daily video game guessing challenges. Identify games from screenshots, climb live leaderboards, unlock achievements. Play instantly as a guest — no account needed.

records.name: Loremill
records.tagline: An AI video-gaming companion for gamers that love GDR
records.description: Loremill is an AI companion for GDR gamers that answers your questions with cited sources for every claim. No more hallucinated spell names, made-up item stats, or invented quest paths. It pulls live from the web (Perplexity Sonar), Claude rewrites the answer in a game personalized tone that doesn't sound like a wiki, and every citation is clickable so you can verify it yourself. (including links to youtube video sources) 30+ games at launch. Personal library. Free during beta.

records.name: hyxe.ai
records.tagline: Your brand's influencer. Built. Owned. Yours.
records.description: Hyxe turns any website into a brand-owned AI influencer and ad campaign engine. Paste your URL, confirm your Brand DNA, choose a custom influencer persona, and generate ready-to-test UGC, product demo, social proof, and product highlight ads in minutes.

records.name: #Pad
records.tagline: Organize your notes and text files with #tags
records.description: A smart notepad / text editor that organizes your files with #tags. Manage reminders, tasks, use a professional editor and extend capabilities with Python plugins. Available for macOS and Windows.

records.name: SaaSyBase
records.tagline: System to help you launch your SaaS product faster
records.description: SaaSyBase is a free Next.js SaaS boilerplate with three auth providers, four payment processors, subscriptions, teams, admin dashboard, optional Infisical or Doppler bootstrap, and 500+ automated tests across 140+ files plus manual regression coverage - all wired up.

records.name: Burn2Earn
records.tagline: Earn gift cards for completing fitness challenges
records.description: Most fitness apps give streaks and badges. Burn2Earn gives actual rewards — Amazon, Apple, Steam, and 325+ other gift cards. Pick a fitness challenge (steps, calories, or workout minutes). Commit by enrolling. Complete it to earn reward points redeemable in our store. Miss it and you keep your motivation for next time. Premium subscribers unlock more challenges and 2x reward multipliers. Available now on iOS and Android.

records.name: Share Cart URL for WooCommerce
records.tagline: Share pre-filled WooCommerce carts by link
records.description: Share Cart URL for WooCommerce lets merchants create pre-filled cart links that add products, quantities, and variations directly to a customer's WooCommerce cart. It is useful for campaigns, support replies, bundles, reorder flows, and checkout shortcuts where shoppers should land with the right items already selected.

records.name: bAI, Re-imagining Family Travel
records.tagline: Tap. Talk. Travel
records.description: Stop spending hours planning family trips across 40 browser tabs. bAI's voice + chat agent Zara learns your kids, your budget, and your style — then books the whole trip end-to-end in one conversation. Other AI travel tools are great but built for general travelers. bAI is different: 🎙️ Voice + chat — hands-free for busy parents 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-specialized — rooms, kid menus, strollers ✈️ End-to-end booking — flights (Duffel), hotels (Amadeus), rides (Uber) 🤝 B2C + B2B on one platform
